paper.title_en: A first look at strange-quark polarization in top-quark decays with CMS Open Data
paper.abstract_en: We present a first realization of strange-quark polarimetry in top-quark decays. The longitudinal polarization of $Λ$ baryons is measured in the strange jets of hadronic $W\to c\bar s$ decays in semileptonic top-quark pair events, using 16.39 fb$^{-1}$ of the public CMS data of pp collisions at $\sqrt{s}=13$ TeV. The $W$ decay produces the strange quark fully polarized, so that the $Λ$ polarization measures the transfer of the quark polarization in fragmentation. With the limited statistics available, our result is consistent both with zero and with the transfer inferred from the flavor-averaged LEP measurements. The statistical reach with the full Run-2, Run-3 and HL-LHC datasets is projected.
